summary: XPeng Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a record date for its forthcoming annual general meeting (AGM). The Board fixed May 14, 2026 as the record date for Class A and Class B ordinary shares and for ADS holders to vote. This is a routine procedural notice required for shareholder meetings, not a special situation event. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. It is purely administrative, with no transaction terms or structural changes.
